note: Layers are square transparent PNGs on one shared canvas (authored at 2000x2000, shipped at 1000x1000), so they stack with no offsets. Draw in list order, first = bottom. An accessory layer must be a square transparent PNG drawn on the same canvas; it is inserted at a slot: 'after' = directly above the named layer, 'before' = directly below it. Do not trim layers. Source: Erika's layered Canva PDF Guitars_Jalapresto.pdf, page 1, 2026-11-11. The fretting arm is under the guitar; the fingertip dots and the strumming arm are on top.

clothing_torso.note: shirts, scarves, bow ties; stays under the face, guitar and arms

face.note: glasses, masks; above the eyes, brows, teeth and mustache

clothing_lower.note: skirts and dresses; over the legs and boots, under the instrument and arms

monocle.note: monocle lens: above the eyes, under the teeth and mustache (the chain uses the face slot, over the mustache)

pants_back.note: the pant leg of the straight (back) leg

shoes_mid_under.note: sole of the crossed foot, in front of the back pant leg

pants_foot.note: the crossed foot again, in front of the back pant leg

pants.note: the pant leg of the crossed (front) leg; under instruments

shirt.note: shirt body: over the legs, the pants waistband and its own sleeves; under instruments and arms

shirt_sleeves.note: shirt sleeves: joined to the shirt, behind its body

shoes_over_pants.note: the crossed foot's shoe, in front of both pant legs

tee_arm_over.note: the fretting arm, in front of the instrument

tee_sleeve_over.note: the part of a sleeve that shows beside the shirt, in front of the instrument
